name: Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner
summary: The first Dreamliner: a mid-size, long-range twinjet with a carbon-fiber composite fuselage and highly flexible raked wings.

still.throttle: the package draws its throttle quadrant without separate levers, so there is nothing to move
still.controls: the package draws no control yokes or rudder pedals in its flight deck

asset.author: Omega95, Redneck, Jentron and the 787-8 contributors
